column1: # Measurement workloads, parsed as data by tests/live/collect.sh (never sourced).
# Columns (tab-separated): workload  cache_class  qname_template  qtype
#   cache_class is the declared expectation: miss | hit | hit-after-idle | after-wake
#   | after-restart
#   {nonce} expands to 16 fresh hex digits per query, so a cold query can
#   never be answered from cache. Names are synthetic and controlled: no
#   client query history ever enters a sample file.
#   example.com is IANA-reserved and DNSSEC-signed, so every workload also
#   exercises validation; random labels return a signed NXDOMAIN, which is a
#   valid answer, not a failure.
# Orchestration (priming before warm, the idle pause, the sleep/wake event)
# belongs to the caller; the collector only labels and times the queries.
# restart (DEC-014) is the one exception: its sample is the time from a stack
# restart to the first answered query, so tests/live/target.sh arm-set times
# it from the restart command and collect.sh refuses it.
cold
warm
idle
wake
restart
